interface_changes: Added ConstructionSiteCollector in model/discovery.py. It scopes construction provenance to one model factory invocation and returns source locations plus counts for live returned-model instances only.
construction.py re-exports project_construction_site for the existing model package API and filters captured identities against the returned model graph.
implemented: Construction capture retains strong references during the factory call, preventing Python id reuse from assigning one instance’s source site to a different instance.
Source-site counts now include only distinct live modules reachable from the returned model. Temporary modules created and discarded at the same source line do not incorrectly disable source editing.
The application model job builder was reviewed: Inspect already starts from empty_job and does not require training configuration; no application change was needed.

Added a CLI integration test covering direct root inspection without project initialization/training config, shared aliases, a user-defined Sequential subclass, construction and class source locations, discarded same-site modules, and invalid/raising factories.
